Stability & beyond-use dating

Compound with data behind you

Over 150 published stability studies cover ORA® vehicles across common extemporaneous formulations. When a beyond-use date is challenged at accreditation or audit, the literature is there to support it.

  • Peer-reviewed data for paediatric and geriatric suspensions
  • Buffered to a slightly acidic pH to limit oxidative degradation
  • Consistent, reproducible vehicle batch to batch

Why ORA®?

What a manufacturer-made vehicle gives you that an in-house recipe cannot.

ORA® range

Recommended

Manufacturer-controlled vehicles with published data behind every claim.

  • 150+ published stability studies
  • Sugar-free vehicles available, ORA-Sweet® SF and ORA-Blend® SF
  • Room-temperature stable, refrigeration optional
  • Ready to use, no bench prep required
  • Batch-to-batch consistency, manufacturer controlled
  • Buffered and preserved to a defined specification
  • Hospital formulary standard
  • Australian Padagis supplier, ships in 24–48 hrs

The alternatives

Simple syrup and in-house vehicles, and what they leave you to carry.

  • No published stability data, or none for your formulation
  • Sugar-free options limited or unavailable
  • Short shelf life, or stability you cannot evidence
  • Bench time on every batch
  • Consistency depends on the operator
  • Buffering and preservation vary with the recipe
  • Harder to defend at accreditation
  • Supply depends on in-house capacity
